units.source_text: 动身那一天黎明时分，天还未大亮，就准备出发。

en.t: At dawn on the day of departure, before the sky was fully light, they prepared to set out.

units.source_text: 京中派来迎接的人都来了，

en.t: Everyone sent from the capital to escort them had arrived,

units.source_text: 人声嘈杂，源氏公子心情迷惘，还是找个人少的机会，赋诗赠明石姬：

en.t: and amid the clamor of voices, Prince Genji felt bewildered, yet he still found a moment when few people were nearby and composed a poem for Lady Akashi:
